claims.sentence: You have the right to choose the topic of your diploma project or diploma work
You may propose your own theme, provided you justify the feasibility of its development for practical application
You may base the content of your diploma project or diploma work on the results of a coursework or project you previously completed within the relevant professional module
You may also base it on the results of previously completed practical assignments
You may use automated design and management systems to prepare the documentation for your diploma project or diploma work
Your chosen topic must correspond to the content of one or more professional modules included in your secondary vocational education educational program
The topic must meet modern requirements for the development of high-tech sectors of science, production, economy, culture, and education
The topic must have a practice-oriented character
Your work should be performed, if possible, based on proposals or orders from enterprises, organizations, innovative companies, high-tech productions, or educational organizations
Your diploma project or diploma work must correspond to the developed assignment
It must include an analysis of sources with generalizations, conclusions, comparisons, and an evaluation of different viewpoints

It must demonstrate the required level of general scientific and specialized training, and your ability to apply mastered knowledge, practical skills, and general and professional competencies in practice according to FGOS SPO
The work must include a title page, an explanatory note, a theoretical part, and a practical (graphic) part
The explanatory note (introduction) must justify the relevance of the chosen topic and formulate the components of the conceptual apparatus
The theoretical part must provide a theoretical overview of the topic based on an analysis of existing literature
The practical part may be presented as a methodology, calculations, analysis of experimental data, or a creative product according to the types of professional activity
The content of the explanatory note, theoretical, and practical parts is determined depending on the specialty profile
The volume of your diploma project or diploma work is determined based on the specifics of your specialty

If you perform the work in the form of experimental samples of products, products, etc., or as a creative work, the number of pages in the explanatory note may be reduced without reducing the overall quality of the work
Depending on the character of your work, specific content features must be reflected

If your work is experimental-practical, it must be aimed at solving the chosen problem and consist of designing professional activity, describing its implementation, and evaluating its effectiveness, with a conclusion containing conclusions and recommendations regarding the possibilities of practical application of the results

If your work is experimental-experimental, it must present a plan for conducting the experiment, a characterization of experimental work methods, the main stages of the experiment (constituent, formative, control), and an analysis of the experimental work results, with a conclusion containing conclusions and recommendations regarding the possibilities of practical application of the results

If your work is theoretical, the theoretical part must contain the history of the issue, justification of the developed problem in theory and practice through a deep comparative analysis of literature, with a conclusion containing conclusions and recommendations regarding the possibilities of using the research materials
Your completed diploma project or diploma work is subject to mandatory review
External review is conducted to ensure objectivity in evaluating your work

The work is reviewed by a specialist from among leading specialists of enterprises, government bodies, the labor and education sphere, research institutes, or teachers of the educational organization who are knowledgeable in issues related to the topic of your diploma project or diploma work
Reviewers are appointed by an order of the College Director no later than one month before the defense
You cannot make changes to your diploma project or diploma work after receiving the review
